incident_spec.summary: Concurrent UPDATE statements on a single row in a small table cause significant delays due to locking contention.
symptoms: UPDATE statements take minutes to complete despite the small table size.
Locks are observed with significant age values.
incident_spec.mechanism: Row-level locking contention due to concurrent updates targeting the same row.

assumptions: The issue is caused by row-level locking contention due to concurrent updates.
